title: Pricing Data Scientist
description:
Pricing Data Scientist

Remote (UK) | Up to £100,000 + Benefits

This is an opportunity to join a growing analytics function where you'll help shape pricing capability from the ground up. Working across data science, machine learning, and pricing analytics, you'll deliver measurable commercial impact while helping to build modern tools, models, and processes.

The Company

They are a data-driven insurance business investing heavily in pricing transformation and analytics capability. With a strong focus on automation and innovation, they offer an environment where technical expertise is valued and new ideas can directly influence business performance.

The Role

  • Develop and validate statistical and machine learning models in Python.
  • Analyse pricing data to identify trends, opportunities, and performance drivers.
  • Assess the impact of pricing changes and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Build automation and tooling to improve pricing processes.
  • Partner with pricing, underwriting, and data teams to deliver commercial insights.
  • Present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong Python and SQL skills.
  • Commercial experience in data science, predictive modelling, or statistical analysis.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving ability.
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills.
  • Degree in a highly quantitative subject such as Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or Physics.
  • Insurance pricing experience.
  • Exposure to Databricks, Azure, cloud platforms, or MLOps.

What They Offer

  • Up to £100,000 salary.
  • Fully remote working.
  • Competitive benefits package.
  • Opportunity to shape a growing pricing and data science function.
  • Clear progression and development opportunities.

How to Apply

If you're looking for a high-impact Pricing Data Scientist role where you can combine advanced analytics with commercial decision-making, please apply today.
